description.value: Bean Around The World is a long-running BC coffee roaster with over 30 years of history, operating a cafe at the UBC campus area on Thunderbird Boulevard. The company sources organic and ethically traded beans from around the world and roasts daily in small batches. Cyclists riding the UBC loop or Spanish Banks routes would find this a recognizable chain stop with outdoor seating noted in OSM.

The website is an e-commerce/roastery site and does not describe the specific Thunderbird Blvd cafe location, so almost no amenity claims can be confirmed from it. OSM amenity tags (internet_access=wlan, wheelchair=yes, takeaway=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes, outdoor_seating=yes) are present but cannot be treated as authoritative per the evidence rules since the website does not corroborate them.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM lists 6308 Thunderbird Boulevard, Vancouver (V6T 1Z4, UBC area), but the website consistently shows 1462 Columbia Street, North Vancouver, V7J 1A2 as the company address.
Phone mismatch: OSM lists +1 604 568 8893 (local number) but the website's contact number is 1-888-294-1111 (toll-free corporate line).

The website is an e-commerce/roastery site and does not include content specific to the Thunderbird Blvd cafe location — the Locations subpage was not captured in the prefetch, so cafe-level amenities cannot be confirmed.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM cafe record at 6308 Thunderbird Blvd (UBC area) appears to be a real physical location, but the linked website is the chain's North Vancouver roastery HQ and does not describe this specific cafe. The address and phone number on the website both differ from OSM, so the listing cannot be verified without checking the chain's Locations page or visiting the site.
